brief:
Israeli occupation forces detained an agricultural tractor in the northern Jordan Valley on Monday evening, Shehab Wire reported. The seizure marked the latest in a series of equipment confiscations affecting Palestinian farmers in the territory.

The incident occurred as Palestinian communities in the Jordan Valley continue to face restrictions on agricultural operations. Israeli military actions in the area have routinely targeted farming infrastructure and equipment used by local residents. The circumstances surrounding the specific detention and the identity of the tractor's owner remained unclear at the time of the report.
